description: The Plastic Waste Segregator is responsible for identifying, classifying, and sorting various types of plastic waste, followed by cleaning, pre-processing, and ensuring compliance with safety, environmental, and waste management norms. The role demands basic operational skills, awareness of plastic categories, and the ability to follow routine instructions under supervision.
